sloka: स जित्वा धनदं राम भ्रातरं राक्षसाधिपः ।महासेनप्रसूतिं तद्ययौ शरवणं महत् ।। ७.१६.१ ॥
transliteration: sa jitvā dhanadaṁ rāma bhrātaraṁ rākṣasādhipaḥ ।mahāsenaprasūtiṁ tadyayau śaravaṇaṁ mahat ।। 7.16.1 ॥

translations.english: O Rama, having conquered his brother Kubera, the lord of Rakshasas then went to that great thicket of reeds, the birthplace of Kartikeya.
